description: One delivered message signed end to end, for the path no other vector covers: the X-ZEKNOP-* fields of the message, both hashes recomputed from it, the signature input of signature-input.md §2 and an Ed25519 signature that holds over it. The key is published here and is the key of no deployment; the message was built by the Python example client of this package.

key.about: sha256 of seed_text is the Ed25519 seed; never use it for anything else
key.seed_text: ZEKNOP Developer Preview: the example key. It signs for no deployment.

identity_answer.about: what GET /v1/verify/{identity_uuid} would answer for this identity, the fields the check needs (../../api/README.md, 'The keys of an identity')
